description:
The 'GlobalNews' app needs to be updated for the Middle East market (RTL support). The project is already open in Android Studio.

Your tasks:
1. Open `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` and enable RTL support by adding `android:supportsRtl="true"` to the `<application>` tag.
2. Open `app/src/main/res/layout/activity_profile.xml` and refactor all legacy directional attributes to their modern equivalents:
   - Change `layout_marginLeft` to `layout_marginStart`
   - Change `layout_marginRight` to `layout_marginEnd`
   - Change `paddingLeft` to `paddingStart`
   - Change `paddingRight` to `paddingEnd`
   - Update any `gravity` or `layout_gravity` values from `left`/`right` to `start`/`end`
   - Update any `layout_alignParentLeft`/`Right` to `layout_alignParentStart`/`End`

Ensure the project builds successfully after your changes.
